channel.title: International Accounting Bulletin - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Accounting Bulletin (internationalaccountingbulletin.com)

item.title: PwC Australia sets out next steps in company-wide AI upskilling drive
item.description: PwC Australia has unveiled the next phase of its workforce AI upskilling programme to prepare its staff, partners and clients for a changing professional services market.

item.title: HaysMac appoints Phil Clayton as partner in private client tax practice
item.description: HaysMac, a UK-based chartered accountancy and tax advisory practice, has appointed Phil Clayton as a partner in its private client tax team.

item.title: UHY adds Lisbon-based audit practice to network
item.description: International accounting network UHY has expanded its presence in Portugal by admitting Lisbon-based André, Graça & Associados.

item.title: MHA names Craig McSherry as banking and capital markets partner
item.description: UK-based professional services firm MHA has appointed Craig McSherry as a partner in its banking and capital markets practice.

item.title: PwC launches PwC One platform in push towards AI-led delivery model
item.description: PwC has launched PwC One, an AI-powered platform the firm is positioning as a step in its move towards AI-enabled professional services.

item.title: Wolters Kluwer adds AI support for Italian tax filings to Genya cloud platform
item.description: Wolters Kluwer Tax and Accounting Italy has launched Genya Dichiarativi Expert AI, a new capability built into the Genya cloud platform.

item.title: Grant Thornton UAE appoints ten new partners
item.description: Grant Thornton UAE has announced appointment of ten new partners as it expands its senior leadership team in the country.

item.title: bk plus acquires London accountancy practice Freeman Carr
item.description: UK accountancy group bk plus has moved into the London market through the acquisition of local firm Freeman Carr.

item.title: Dext rolls out AI agent to support bookkeeping workflows
item.description: Dext, part of IRIS Software Group, has introduced a new AI agent aimed at helping accountants, bookkeepers and finance teams to streamline bookkeeping decisions.

item.title: TaxGPT introduces autonomous tool for tax returns
item.description: US-based software firm TaxGPT has introduced Tax Prep Agent, an autonomous tax workflow system developed for accounting and tax professionals.
